title: Anchored Insights — Compact Mode: Visual Polish, QA, and Stakeholder Synthesis
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Goal: Finalize visual polish and QA checklist for the new 'Anchored Insights' compact card in the Console cost and rollout dashboards. This ticket covers: final redlines for density mode, microstate animations for expanded summaries, keyboard and screen-reader behavior, handoff artifacts for engineering, and a short stakeholder synthesis for PM and product leadership. The compact card is intended as a high-density glance for customers with constrained vertical space and frequent monitoring needs. We need to ensure token-cost breakdowns remain readable and that rollouts microcopy shows clear canary/fallback states.
acceptance_criteria: Final Figma redlines applied and exported tokens/spacing variables provided to frontend
QA checklist passed: keyboard navigation, focus states, contrast WCAG 2.1 AA, and responsive wrap at 320/480/768 px
Engineer feedback loop closed with <20% layout delta from spec across browsers
Stakeholder signoff from PM (Samir Patel) and Design Lead (Lina Brooks)
decision_log: 2026-03-02: Persisted compact density over a pared back micro-chart; trade-off chosen to favor token info density over miniature sparklines after latency/visual noise review.
2026-03-05: Agreed to use a collapsible details row for rollouts info rather than a modal to reduce navigation friction on mobile.
2026-03-09: Chose color ramp 'Cedar-700' for severity tags to increase contrast with dark theme based on accessibility audit.
2026-03-11: Decided to expose a lightweight 'preview' tooltip on hover for rate estimates instead of inline copy to preserve vertical space.
comments: 2026-03-01 - Ava Martinez: Uploaded initial prototype and callout for tokens vs cost layout. Requesting early engineering input on DOM complexity for live token breakdown.
2026-03-03 - Rory Chen: Scoped expected CSS variables and suggested simplifying grid to flex to handle shrink behavior. Noted potential perf hit with 3 nested transitions.
2026-03-04 - Samir Patel (PM): Love the compactness — confirm that the canary badge will be visible at 320px width. Also requested copy variant for 'fallback' state.
2026-03-06 - Accessibility review (J. Okoro): Contrast OK except severity tag in dark theme, recommend swapping to Cedar-700 and adding 3px focus ring.
2026-03-08 - Lina Brooks (Design Lead): Provided redlines for typography scale and requested micro-interaction timing baked into the spec (120ms for fade, 180ms for slide).

2026-03-10 - Rory Chen: Implemented initial CSS in feature branch, shared screenshots of pixel deltas. Noted one edge case where token column collapses when tooltip present; suggested limiting tooltip to tap only on mobile.

2026-03-12 - QA (M. Rivera): Ran through acceptance checklist on Chrome/Firefox/Safari and flagged two bugs: focus order on rollout details and missing aria-label on preview toggle. Both assigned to ENG-76219.
2026-03-12 - Samir Patel: Stakeholder sync complete. PM signoff pending QA fixes; target ship in console-2026.03 if fixes land this week.
follow_up_tasks: Address accessibility flags: contrast and aria-labels (owner: Rory Chen, deps: ENG-76219)
Engineer: resolve tooltip mobile behavior and re-run layout QA (owner: ENG team)
Design: export updated tokens and motion specs to the engineering token library and post PR comments on GH (#2487)
Product: publish short customer-facing note about compact mode availability and behavior (owner: Samir Patel)
notes: Prototype differs from previous cost tiles by anchoring the metric label to the left to reduce eye travel when scanning many rows.
We are intentionally using a minimal microcopy approach; any expanded explanations live in hover previews to keep density high.
If QA uncovers more than two layout regressions, consider postponing ship and rolling as an opt-in beta behind a feature flag.
